name: Niwa Mizuho
source: Class rep for Hawaii Inn. Likes to take her time understanding what others are talking about, which gives off the impression that she’s not a good thinker. As it turns out, she’s as upstanding as could be. Sees the idea of a guy cheating on his partner to be absolutely evil.
